comment.body: This capability is already available in current PowerToys: Command Palette and PowerToys Run include a Windows Settings provider that searches Settings and Control Panel tasks, including environment-variable entries, and PowerToys also exposes Environment Variables directly. Please try the current release. If one specific setting is missing, provide the exact search text and expected result in a focused report so that alias or entry can be corrected.
